verification_report.summary: Correct conditional on Standard Inputs 1–4. The proof was checked in textual order through 17 items and 94 deduction checks. The local cutoff integrations use closed psh factors and the Euclidean Kahler form, so they do not require omega to be closed. Controlling the smooth remainder gives C_omega(1+A)^n and proves finite total capacity. For bounded u, writing f=e^{au}, H=omega+ddc F_a(u), and B=omega+ddc u, the identity H^n-f^n B^n=sum_{k=0}^{n-1} f^k H^{n-1-k} wedge B^k wedge (H-fB) reduces the transform comparison to the positive mixed products expressly supplied by Input 2. For unbounded u, bounded truncations, locality on {u>-t}, and exhaustion outside the null pole set give the claimed measure inequality without an unbounded chain rule. Choosing a=p/n yields C_omega(1+p^{-1})^n after a dimensional enlargement independent of p and u; scaling the bounded transform gives exactly max(1,n/p)^n Cap_omega(E). The sublevel estimate follows with p=(1+t)^{-1}. Sigma-finite Tonelli gives polynomial total mass at most Cq/(q-n) and the tail Cq/(q-n)(1+T)^{n-q} for q>n, including correct treatment of level-zero mass and strict tails. Splitting at T=Cap_omega(E)^{-1/q} proves the exponent 1-n/q; zero and large capacities are handled correctly. For continuity, the fixed-T coefficient is continuous, uniformly bounded and quasi-continuous, converges in capacity, and vanishes on the truncation level, so Input 4 applies to the exact weighted truncation identity. Uniform exponential and polynomial tails justify taking j to infinity first and then T to infinity against every continuous test function. The normalization and fixed semipositive-background remarks are consistent with these arguments. Connectedness is harmlessly redundant. The reference audit found only stipulated hypotheses and internally proved results, with no external-paper reference requiring a search. No bounded-mass premise, undamped mass-finiteness conclusion, optimality assertion, or novelty claim is used. No critical errors or gaps were found.
